name: corrected-mt-bench-ja
description:
# Corrected MT-Bench-ja

Inflection AIによる[Corrected MT-Bench](https://github.com/InflectionAI/Inflection-Benchmarks)の日本語訳です。
一部の設問はStability AIによる[Japanese MT-Bench](https://github.com/Stability-AI/FastChat)を使用しています。
reputation: Japanese localization of the Corrected MT-Bench; builds on a well-known MT-Bench lineage and is useful for Japanese MT quality comparisons, though adoption is moderate.
